fee_notes: The initial franchise fee is a flat $8,000, non-refundable, due in full when the Franchise Agreement is signed by both parties. This fee applies equally to new franchisees, Converting Mac Distributors, and Converting Franchisees/Distributors/Employees. Additional routes require a separate computer system and Starter Inventory purchase but the document does not explicitly state an additional $8,000 fee per additional route in this excerpt.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us a non-refundable initial franchise fee of $8,000, which is due in full when the Franchise Agreement is signed by both you and us.
